description:
List notes and/or folders in the vault, optionally scoped to a `folder` and filtered by creation/modification date. `include` selects what to return (`notes`, `folders`, or `both`). `recursive:true` descends into subfolders. `since`/`until` (ISO dates) combined with `dateField` (`created` or `modified`, default `modified`) narrow the result by date. Read-only.

Operates on the session-active vault (see `vault.current` — selectable via `vault.select`) unless an explicit `vaultPath` argument is passed, which always wins.

dateField.description: Which date the `since`/`until` filter applies to. Defaults to `modified`.

folder.description: Optional folder to scope the listing.

include.description: What to list — markdown notes, folders, or both (returns items tagged by kind).

since.description: Only include items dated on or after this ISO date.

until.description: Only include items dated on or before this ISO date.

name: notes.list

outputSchema.description: Standard list envelope used by list/search tools.

items.description: List of result items; per-item shape depends on the tool.
Freeform object. The specific shape depends on the tool; see the tool description.

title: List Notes And Folders
